summary.text: Tyreek Goodman is the Conservative Party nominee for NY Assembly District 84 and a Bronx resident. He has run for office twice before without success: for this Assembly seat in 2024 (2.9%) and for New York City Council District 8 in 2025 (12.0%). He has not held elected office.

paragraphs.text: A Bronx resident who, according to a Bronx Times report, said he once was disillusioned with politics and never saw himself running for office until fellow Conservative Gonzalo Duran challenged him to step up.
Ran for NY Assembly District 84 in 2024 on the Conservative Party line, finishing third with 2.9% of the vote behind Amanda Septimo (D/WFP) and Rosaline Nieves (R).

Announced a bid for New York City Council at a December 14, 2024 Bronx Conservative Party gathering, then ran for Council District 8 in the November 4, 2025 general election on the Republican and Conservative Party lines, finishing second with 12.0% of the vote (3,486 votes) behind Elsie Encarnacion.

Was endorsed by the Bronx Conservative Party as its 2026 candidate for State Assembly District 84, where he described a campaign concept called People Over Politics and said the party should educate voters about conservatism.
